evidence_boundary: This manifest schedules staged pilot, admission, replication, and confirmatory work. It does not authorize confirmatory collection by itself.

lane_order.scope: provider readiness, adapter conformance, run-record audit, and SUT health sentinels
lane_order.exit_gate: every available provider/arm has a bounded readiness record and every blocked provider is explicitly classified

lane_order.scope: complete eight workflow slots per local SUT before admitting an application
lane_order.exit_gate: all bound workflows pass reset, independent oracle, fault positive/negative, evolution invariant, and three-arm replay contracts

lane_order.scope: verify and admit candidate applications without substituting candidate blueprints for evidence
lane_order.exit_gate: each candidate is admitted, rejected with evidence, or parked as blocked

lane_order.scope: stratified replication across Qwen, DeepSeek, Doubao when available, and conformed agent frameworks
lane_order.exit_gate: adapter conformance, same intent/state/budget, complete run records, and independent oracle linkage
both endpoint applications are admitted and handoff state has an independent oracle

lane_order.scope: pilot variance, power simulation, preregistered freeze, and 14-repetition collection
lane_order.exit_gate: admission, variance, power, ledger, and analysis-hash gates are all green

branch_policy.trigger: provider readiness is green and matched runs have complete records
branch_policy.action: continue the balanced cell queue for that provider/model stratum
branch_policy.allow: pilot accumulation and later labelled replication
branch_policy.deny: pooling with another provider before the interaction design is frozen

branch_policy.trigger: 429, 5xx, timeout, malformed response, or key/base-url mismatch
branch_policy.action: retain blocked record, stop that provider lane, continue independent lanes, and backfill the exact missing cell after recovery
branch_policy.deny: counting the provider failure as task failure or success

branch_policy.trigger: reset, isolation, mutation, evolution invariant, or independent oracle is not reproducible
branch_policy.action: park the application/workflow and open a repair issue; advance the next candidate only if no endpoint dependency is pending
branch_policy.deny: replacing the blocked workflow with repetitions of another workflow

branch_policy.trigger: provider is healthy and the same matched task repeatedly reaches an agent grounding, termination, or budget boundary
branch_policy.action: run one pre-specified bounded ablation, then classify the boundary without relabelling it as infrastructure failure

branch_policy.trigger: duplicate run id, incomplete matched cell, missing step evidence, or cross-cell contamination
branch_policy.action: invalidate the affected block, repair the writer, rerun with a fresh campaign tag, and preserve the invalid artifact outside the analysis denominator

branch_policy.trigger: pilot variance cannot support the full interaction set at the declared budget
branch_policy.action: reduce the pre-specified interaction scope before collection; preserve the primary conditional estimand

concurrency_contract.provider_request_policy: per-profile bounded concurrency with exponential backoff; no retry after terminal schema or auth failure
concurrency_contract.reset_boundary: every repetition starts from a fresh deterministic reset digest
concurrency_contract.cross_app_policy: no cross-app execution until both endpoint applications are admitted
concurrency_contract.confirmatory_policy: concurrency is frozen only after pilot variance and power simulation

required_before_expansion: complete the remaining workflow gate for the active application
audit one aggregate ledger per matched block
